hooks.command: if [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && devenv_env=$(devenv --quiet print-dev-env --json) && devenv_exports=$(printf '%s' "$devenv_env" | jq -r '.variables | to_entries[] | select(.value.type == "exported") | select(.key | IN("HOME", "TMPDIR", "TEMP", "TMP", "TEMPDIR", "NIX_BUILD_TOP", "NIX_ENFORCE_PURITY", "NIX_LOG_FD", "SHELL", "TERM", "PWD", "OLDPWD", "SHLVL", "SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH") | not) | if .key == "PATH" then "export PATH=\(.value.value | @sh):\"$PATH\"" else "export \(.key)=\(.value.value | @sh)" end') && printf '%s\n' "$devenv_exports" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi
